description: This file contains extensions to the NodeAppModel class, providing methods for resolving URLs related to Canvas hosts and A2 UI hosts, normalizing URLs for trust comparison, and managing UI state related to Canvas connections in an iOS application.

classes.name: NodeAppModel
classes.description: An extension to the NodeAppModel class providing URL resolution, normalization, and UI management methods.

methods.name: resolveCanvasHostURL
methods.description: Resolves and returns the Canvas host URL after validation and trimming. Returns nil if the URL is not valid or is a loopback address.

methods.name: resolveA2UIHostURL
methods.description: Resolves and returns the A2 UI host URL with a specific path appended, or nil if invalid.

methods.name: normalizeURLForTrustComparison
methods.description: Normalizes a URL string for trust comparison by lowercasing scheme and host, and stripping fragments.

methods.name: showA2UIOnConnectIfNeeded
methods.description: Sets the last auto A2 UI URL to nil and shows the default canvas when connecting.

methods.name: ensureA2UIReadyWithCapabilityRefresh
methods.description: Ensures the A2 UI is ready, attempting to refresh capabilities if necessary, and returning the current state as an enum.

methods.name: showLocalCanvasOnDisconnect
methods.description: Shows the default local canvas view after a disconnect.

methods.name: resolveA2UIHostURLWithCapabilityRefresh
methods.description: Attempts to resolve the A2 UI host URL, refreshing node canvas capability if necessary.

methods.name: resolveCanvasHostURLWithCapabilityRefresh
methods.description: Attempts to resolve the Canvas host URL, refreshing node canvas capability if necessary.

methods.name: probeTCP
methods.description: Performs a TCP probe to check connectivity to the URL's host and port.
